dataDefinition.xml:
<system-data-structure>
  <group identifier="page-content" label="Page Layout Options">
    <text default="Columned Layout" field-id="746487a0ac10010670f1d5959177c5c3" help-text="Content area layout can be Full Width (without left and right column options) or columned with left and/or right columns" identifier="layout" label="Select Content Area Layout" required="true" type="radiobutton">
      <radio-item show-fields="page-content/main-content/full-width-color, page-content/impact/caption" value="Full Width Layout"/>
      <radio-item show-fields="page-content/left-column, page-content/right-column, page-content/main-content/spotlight/note" value="Columned Layout"/>
    </text>
    <group collapsed="true" identifier="left-column" label="Left Column">
      <text default="Yes" field-id="746487a0ac10010670f1d595df301d34" identifier="display-left-column" label="Display Left Column?" type="radiobutton">
        <radio-item value="Yes"/>
        <radio-item value="No"/>
      </text>
    </group>
    <group collapsed="true" identifier="right-column" label="Right Column">
      <text default="No" field-id="746487a1ac10010670f1d595592ca993" identifier="display" label="Display Right Column?" required="true" type="radiobutton">
        <radio-item show-fields="page-content/right-column/display-navigation, page-content/right-column/widget" value="Yes"/>
        <radio-item value="No"/>
      </text>
      <asset field-id="746487a1ac10010670f1d595918f8993" identifier="widget" label="Widget" multiple="true" render-content-depth="unlimited" restrict-to-folder="/_widgets" type="page"/>
    </group>
  </group>
  <group identifier="post_details" label="Post Details">
    <text field-id="87e8a707ac10010f0968323b2039290c" identifier="postType" label="Type of Post" required="true" type="radiobutton">
      <radio-item label="Press Release" value="press"/>
      <radio-item label="Student Success Story" value="student"/>
      <radio-item label="Featured Faculty" show-fields="post_details/dirLink" value="faculty"/>
      <radio-item label="Podcast" show-fields="post_details/pod-series" value="pod"/>
    </text>
    <text field-id="33965aefac10010e6406fbc750394629" identifier="author" label="Author"/>
    <text field-id="33965af0ac10010e6406fbc7a34ca077" help-text="The date that is printed next to the Author Name " identifier="pub_date" label="Publish Date" required="true" type="calendar"/>
    <text field-id="33965af0ac10010e6406fbc707716ed4" identifier="dek" label="Dek (teaser text)" maxlength="160"/>
    <shared-field field-id="a5cf62b0ac10010f0968323b9667152e" help-text="The department the person or event is most closely related to (optional)" identifier="academicDept" path="/Academic Departments"/>
    <text default="cup" field-id="17f38c83ac10010f0c0a3507b6f73a83" identifier="pod-series" label="Podcast Series" required="true" type="dropdown">
      <dropdown-item label="Cup of Knowledge" value="cup"/>
      <dropdown-item label="Cafecito en Casa con CSI" value="cafecito"/>
    </text>
    <asset field-id="2ddd0bdeac10010e6406fbc7bb263f71" identifier="dirLink" label="Person page in the Directory" required="true" restrict-to-folder="/site:///site/" type="page"/>
    <text field-id="2ddd0bdeac10010e6406fbc763b718e7" help-text="If this is cross-posted to socials, you can add the facebook single-post embed code here" identifier="embedFb" label="Facebook embed code (optional)"/>
    <text default="n" field-id="80773ec8ac10010f1b5c85dd439f1314" identifier="eligibleHomepage" label="Make this content eligible for display on the homepage?" required="true" restrict-to-groups="Administrators, PIO" type="radiobutton">
      <radio-item label="Yes" show-fields="post_details/homePageOptions" value="y"/>
      <radio-item label="No" value="n"/>
    </text>
    <group identifier="homePageOptions" label="Homepage Options">
      <asset field-id="ba6a3dbbac10010f0968323b6388122b" help-text="Dimensions: 524px x 320px" identifier="image" label="Image" required="true" restrict-to-folder="/_files/images/homepage" type="file"/>
      <text field-id="ba6a3dbbac10010f0968323b48eb2c5d" identifier="alt" label="Alt Text" required="true"/>
      <text field-id="145e577bac10010f0c0a3507acccdc13" identifier="showHomeStart" label="Date to Start Showing on Homepage" required="true" type="calendar"/>
      <text field-id="145e577bac10010f0c0a3507eb662eae" identifier="showHomeStop" label="Date to Stop Showing on Homepage" required="true" type="calendar"/>
    </group>
  </group>
  <group identifier="content" label="Post Contents">
    <group identifier="hero" label="Featured / Hero Image">
      <text default="image" field-id="87ee4c4bac10010f0968323b8866d880" identifier="heroType" label="Hero Type" required="true" type="radiobutton">
        <radio-item label="Image/Figure" show-fields="content/hero/figure" value="image"/>
        <radio-item label="Video" show-fields="content/hero/video" value="video"/>
        <radio-item label="None" value="none"/>
      </text>
      <shared-field field-id="87ee4c4bac10010f0968323b33bc6c0a" identifier="figure" label="Featured Image" path="/Figure"/>
      <shared-field field-id="87fb19acac10010f0968323b4bfcd22c" identifier="video" path="/Video - Minimal"/>
    </group>
    <group identifier="article" label="Article Section" multiple="true">
      <text default="fullWidth" field-id="964edfd9ac10010f0968323b8e37a2be" identifier="articleSectionLayout" label="Layout for this section of the article" required="true" type="radiobutton">
        <radio-item label="Full Width text" show-fields="content/article/articleSectionText, content/ctaBtn" value="fullWidth"/>
        <radio-item label="Image Only" show-fields="content/article/figure" value="imgOnly"/>
      </text>
      <shared-field field-id="9654292bac10010f0968323b91b30783" identifier="figure" label="Image / Figure" path="/Figure"/>
      <text configuration="minimal - allowed only" field-id="87fb19acac10010f0968323b3856fa81" identifier="articleSectionText" label="Article Section Text" wysiwyg="true"/>
    </group>
    <shared-field field-id="a6d7c492ac10010f0968323b324ef580" identifier="ctaBtn" label="Call to Action button" path="/CTA - Button - Minimal"/>
  </group>
</system-data-structure>
dataDefinition.name: Post
